description: Bounded layer-height mutants checked by nozzle limits, contiguous ranges, adaptive bounds, smoothing, editing, and real sliced-layer contracts.

mutants.description: Use an incorrect half-nozzle default instead of the documented three-quarter-nozzle maximum.
Allow an overlapping custom range to begin before the previous range ends.
Invert the keep-minimum smoothing constraint so smoothing can increase a local height.
Accumulate the fixed nominal layer height instead of the selected variable height.
Raise the zero min_layer_height fallback from 0.07 to 0.09 mm. The adaptive Print contract requires physical sliced layers to reach the documented 0.07 mm minimum.
Accepted physical pipeline probe: changing the static PrintConfig zero-sentinel fallback from 75% to 70% of nozzle diameter is detected by the adaptive Print maximum oracle.
Accepted physical pipeline probe: ignoring the explicit per-nozzle maximum is detected by the adaptive Print 0.25 mm maximum oracle.
